test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is NOT correct with respect to the poverty line?

I. In India, it is normally estimated after every ten years.

II. The proportion of people below the poverty line is not the same for all social groups and economic categories in India.
solution:
Correct Answer **Only I**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• Poverty means that the income level from employment is so low that basic human needs can't be met.
 
• The poverty line varies with time and place.
 
• A poor household is defined as one with an expenditure level below a specific poverty line.
 
• As per the Rangarajan committee report (2014), the poverty line is estimated as a Monthly Per Capita Expenditure of Rs. 1407 in urban areas and Rs. 972 in rural areas.
 
• A common method used to measure poverty is based on income.
 
• Poverty line estimation in India is based on consumption expenditure and not on income levels.
 
• Poverty is measured based on consumer expenditure surveys by the National Sample Survey Organisation.
 
• The incidence of poverty is measured by the poverty ratio, which is the ratio of the number of poor to the total population expressed as a percentage. It is also known as the head-count ratio.
 
• Alagh Committee (1979) determined a poverty line based on a minimum daily requirement of 2400 and 2100 calories for an adult in Rural and Urban areas respectively.
 
• The measurement limits of the poverty line may be based on the consumption levels of the population.
 
• **The poverty line in India is not calculated on a regular ten-year basis. Instead, it is periodically updated by the Government of India.** ***Statement I is Incorrect.**__*
 
• The poverty line is defined as the minimum level of income or consumption necessary to meet basic needs and lead a decent life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information:__**

 
• In 2011, the Suresh Tendulkar Committee defined the poverty line on the basis of monthly spending on food, education, health, electricity and transport.
 
• According to this estimate, a person who spends Rs. 27.2 in rural areas and Rs. 33.3 in urban areas a day are defined as living below the poverty line.
